invariants.name: virtual_list_live_entities_bounded
invariants.note: Issue #8 §3.4 forbids one retained entity per logical row. Bound is the catalog-8 geometric window: uniform_window_item_cap = ceil((800 + 2×160)/20)+2 = 58 (visible + 2×overscan + 2). Missing live_ui_entities stays not-evaluable. live_ui_entities == items is a full list, not virtualization.
